item.title: By: Brian T

item.title: By: Christopher Papastefanou
item.dc:creator: Christopher Papastefanou
item.description:
What I love about the Bad Usability Calendar is that it with every example, identifies the problem and solution in a simple manner. That’s what distinguishes is from many other channels where people just point out the errors of others, which is so easy to do.

However, I strongly disagree with the sentiment “Simplicity is overrated.” on February.
